question: Can you provide the total number of sessions for each traffic channel in December 2020, using the information from the 'event_params'
sql:
-- Final query for total sessions per traffic channel in December 2020
WITH event_params_extracted AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'ga_session_id') AS ga_session_id,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'source') AS source,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'medium') AS medium,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'campaign') AS campaign
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_202012*`
),
session_params AS (
  SELECT
    ga_session_id,
    MAX(source) AS source,
    MAX(medium) AS medium,
    MAX(campaign) AS campaign
  FROM event_params_extracted
  WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
),
session_channel AS (
  SELECT
    ga_session_id,
    source,
    medium,
    campaign,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN campaign IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(campaign) LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (
        (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart'))
        OR (campaign IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop(ping)?'))
      ) AND (LOWER(medium) IN ('cp', 'ppc', 'retargeting', 'paid') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid')) THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex'))
        AND (LOWER(medium) IN ('cp', 'ppc', 'paid') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|paid')) THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp'))
        AND (LOWER(medium) IN ('cp', 'ppc', 'retargeting', 'paid') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid')) THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch'))
        AND (LOWER(medium) IN ('cp', 'ppc', 'retargeting', 'paid') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid')) THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (
        (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart'))
        OR (campaign IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop(ping)?'))
      ) THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp'))
        OR (LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media')) THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch'))
        OR (medium IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'video')) THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex'))
        OR (LOWER(medium) = 'organic') THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail'))
        OR (LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')) THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN (source = 'sms') OR (medium = 'sms') THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN (medium IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'push$'))
        OR (medium IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'mobile|notification')) THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel_group
  FROM session_params
)
SELECT channel_group, COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id) AS total_sessions
FROM session_channel
GROUP BY channel_group
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC
